hold_text: Changes how EVERY automation PR lands: `.github/actions/commit-to-main/action.yml` (27 workflows call it) now writes the R13 merge-slot claim, and `scripts/ci/check_pr_landing.py`'s LANDING_MACHINERY list gains that action plus the new `scripts/ops/claim_merge_slot.py`. R12's own reasoning applies at full force here — a mistake in this diff disarms the check that would have caught the mistake, and it would do so for the whole automation fleet at once. One human read, then merge.
why: Tier-1 by surface (.github/**, scripts/ci/**, scripts/ops/**, tests/**; no src/, no config/, no order path, no deploy/). It is held on R12, not on tier. Adding the two paths to LANDING_MACHINERY is what makes this hold VERIFIABLE by R8 rather than an adjective — and self-landing it while leaving them off the list would be routing around R12 through a gap in its own inventory.
